_comment: M28.4.2 set_data_asset_property soak-only. UDataAsset is not in the inventory pipeline's logic-bearing set (PROJECT_INVENTORY_BRIEF.md §3), so the inspect harness's re-export phase emits zero .md and the inspect gate would always fail. Expanding inventory scope is a separate design decision; for M28.4.2 we keep inspect skipped via `skip_inspect: true` and rely on soak for the determinism signal. The soak gate validates byte-identity of the mutated scratch .uasset across 2 rounds — round 1 populates the empty DA_BpxTestInstance duplicate's Intensity UPROPERTY with 42, round 2 short-circuits via the SetPropertyValue bridge's before==value string compare. Exercises BP-declared variable resolution on a BP-derived DA class (Intensity is declared on DA_BpxTestParentClass via AddMemberVariable; FindFProperty resolves it by the friendly FName). Mirrors the M28.5.3 set_eqs_generator_property soak recipe: source fixture empty, plan populates a single scalar field, round-2 replay validates idempotency.
